items.name: Documented provenance
items.source: OSFI E-23 section 3 (model development and vendor models); NIST AI RMF Map 4.1
items.question: Is it clear who built the model, from what, and under what process?

items.name: License known and compatible
items.source: ISO/IEC 42001 A.10; NIST AI RMF Govern 6.1
items.question: Is the license identified and does it allow commercial use in a regulated setting?

items.name: Model card or system card available
items.source: NIST AI RMF Map 3.4; EU AI Act Art. 53 for general purpose models
items.question: Has the vendor published intended use, limitations and evaluation results?

items.name: Version pinned in code or requirements
items.source: OSFI E-23 section 4 (model inventory and change control); NIST AI RMF Manage 2.4
items.question: Is the exact version fixed so behaviour does not change silently?

items.name: Data residency and retention understood
items.source: OSFI Guideline B-10 third party risk; ISO/IEC 42001 A.7
items.question: Does data leave the organisation, and if so where is it processed and how long is it kept?

items.name: Independent evaluation evidence
items.source: OSFI E-23 section 3 (validation); NIST AI RMF Measure 2.5
items.question: Has the organisation tested the model on its own data rather than relying on vendor claims?

items.name: Vendor incident and deprecation process
items.source: NIST AI RMF Govern 6.2; EU AI Act Art. 73
items.question: Will the vendor tell you when the model changes, fails or is retired, and is there a fallback?
